seed: The transform values live behind an Info button on the tool bar, never over the picture, at Next defaults with no flag changed (the user, 2026-10-12, with a full-canvas recording picked: the old bar sat across its top edge over the handles and the 3D arcs). The recording is picked by a click on the picture: nothing about its transform is drawn over it, and the tool bar carries Info at its right end. A pointer click on Info opens a popover rising out of the tool bar, in its glass and corner, listing X, Y, W, H and Rotation, clear of every handle. 100 typed into X moves the recording; the popover stays open while the recording is dragged and its numbers follow; 15 typed into Rotation turns it and Reset puts the turn back and leaves X alone. Escape closes it and leaves the recording picked.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: the whole recording picked. Its handles along the top edge, the turn knob and its green and red 3D arcs are all in plain sight: nothing about its transform is drawn over the picture. The tool bar has an Info button at its right end

THE SECOND TEST: a click on Info opened the transform values in a popover rising out of the tool bar, in the bar's own glass and corner: X, Y, W, H and Rotation, name on the left and number on the right, Reset at the foot. It covers none of the recording's handles
100 typed into X moved the recording 100 points right; the popover is still open over the tool bar

THE THIRD TEST: the recording dragged with the popover open: it stayed open, the picture held mid drag shows X and Y outlined and following the hand, and it is clear of the handles where the drag left them
THE FOURTH TEST: 15 typed into Rotation turned the recording; Reset put the turn back to nought in one step and left X at 100, because Reset leaves the place alone
Escape closed the popover and nothing else: the recording is still picked, and an arrow key nudges it without the values coming back by themselves
